reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now managed more efficiently, ensuring smoother gameplay. You can shape the ground without worrying about frame freezes when using wells or adjusting terrain. Dive into the details of these changes and see how they enhance your city-building experience! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced Water Mechanics
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce updates to the water mechanics in Provincia! The new native sparse flow system ensures that water depth and terrain modifications happen seamlessly, enhancing your city-building experience. No more frame freezes when manipulating water sources or terrain! Discover all the details and improvements in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
